segments.sn22.19:1.3: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
segments.sn22.19:1.4: Dukkhasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ kuto sukhaṃ bhavissati!
segments.sn22.19:1.5: Vedanā dukkhā … saññā dukkhā … saṅkhārā dukkhā … viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ.
segments.sn22.19:1.9: Yopi hetu yopi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya, sopi dukkho.
segments.sn22.19:1.10: Dukkhasambhūtaṃ, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ kuto sukhaṃ bhavissati!
segments.sn22.19:1.11: Evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī”ti.
